inputs.prompt:
FORMAT: Black and white horror manga page, vertical 800x1424, three stacked horizontal panels, thick black gutters, black outer border. Sharp decisive gekiga linework, heavy ink washes, solid crushed blacks, harsh contrast, grey screentone midtones, cross-hatching. No color, no balloons, no dialogue, no captions, no SFX lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no text anywhere.

PIN from references: the man of Image 1 exactly - late 30s, tall, lean, long even face, dark side-parted hair, dark suit and tie, NO eyeglasses. The woman of Image 2 exactly - mid 50s, heavy-set, broad weathered face, grey-streaked low bun, dark tunic under a knee-length tabard, blank badge - and age her across this page. Keep the lift car and the ink of Image 3. Do not redesign either person.

EYES: take the black sclera EXACTLY as Image 4 draws it. THE EYEBALL IS BLACK - the darkest thing on his face, ink-black across the whole visible eye, no iris, no pupil, no white of any kind, in EVERY panel he appears in. The only light on it is one pinhead catchlight. His eyes are NOT white, NOT pale, NOT glowing; no light comes out of them. They are EYES, not eyewear: normal lids, lashes and brows, no sunglasses, no lenses, no dark discs on the face.

STYLE: Dark psychological horror ink. Cold metal, one hard ceiling light in the car, the corridor beyond crushed to black. Restrained horror - the harm is age, not injury.

TOP (~35%): Extreme close-up of HER FACE, his hand still closed around her throat at the bottom of frame. She is AGEING IN SECONDS: cheeks hollowing, skin slackening into deep folds, lips thinning, the grey in her hair running white from the temples out, loose strands gone brittle. Her eyes are wide and still HERS - irises present, pupils huge, whites bloodshot. Not a corpse yet. Sweat on a face that is drying out as we watch.

MIDDLE (~30%): Extreme close-up of HIS HAND at her throat. Life is being pulled out of her into his palm - fine white filaments and a thin luminous vapour drawn off her neck and collarbone, spiralling into the gaps between his fingers, the back of his hand in tight cross-hatching. Her own hands are on his forearm and already thinning: veins standing, knuckles enlarged, skin loose. No blood, no wound.

BOTTOM (~35%): Camera OUT IN THE BASEMENT CORRIDOR, low, looking back into the lit lift car. He stands in the open doorway holding her up by the throat. SHE IS A FULL-GROWN, HEAVY-SET WOMAN - as tall as his shoulder, broad through the hips, filling as much of the doorway as he does. NOT a child, not doll-sized, not a small figure dangling from his fist. His arm is extended FORWARD at about his own shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent - NOT raised above his head - so her face is level with his and her shoes clear the floor by only a hand's width. Backlit by the car, so he reads mostly as a dark shape - but his head is turned toward the corridor and catches the one ceiling lamp: BOTH EYES SOLID BLACK, wet, and a SMALL TIGHT GRIN. Not a flat silhouette: that lit half of his face must be legible.

SCALE: one human scale, and the two of them are the same species of size - he is ONE HEAD taller than her, no more. She is heavy-set and solid, seven heads tall like any adult; if she reads as small, slight or childlike the panel has failed. The hand at her throat is a normal man's hand, no elongation, no claws. Her feet hang a hand's width off the floor - centimetres, not a metre.

ANATOMY: two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand, thumbs on the correct side. Horizontal panels only, no empty balloon shapes.

CHANGE: only the scene above; preserve both identities, the lift car and the ink from the pins.
